idea-plugin.name: GitHub Web Panel
idea-plugin.description:
Keep GitHub's own website beside your code. Open Issues, pull requests and Projects for the repository detected from Git remotes.

No personal access token is required. Sign in directly on github.com. Browser cookies are managed by Rider and may be shared with other embedded browsers.

Beta: Windows and local Rider 2026.2.1. External SSO, GitHub Enterprise and remote development are not supported. Attachment downloads use your system browser and its separate session. Independent project; not affiliated with GitHub or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First-run connection choice, responsive keyboard-accessible toolbar, page search, persistent zoom and section, access-error guidance, and explicit external-link handling.
